provenance.p_values: recorded: anomalous curve p from manifest result.metrics.anomalous_curve_list; torsion curve p from raw-result.json curves[*].p (arm cm_canonical then random_naive). Each anomalous curve contributes 72 degenerate rows and each torsion curve 12 rows per section, so the row mean equals the curve mean.
provenance.cp95_upper: reviewer-computed by the red team (RT-20261023-fbf42f): one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95 percent upper bound with 0 successes, 1 - 0.05^(1/n); reports/redteam-20261023/rt_power_and_design.json B_null_distribution_per_cell and D_pooled_upper_bounds. plot.py recomputes and checks it.
provenance.mean_inv_sqrt_p: reviewer-computed by plot.py from p_values at render time; not a run output.
provenance.operating_characteristic: reviewer-computed by the red team: rt_power_and_design.json C_operating_characteristic (exact Poisson-binomial over the recorded p_i). Its torsion part treats the three sections as independent; the torsion driver reuses (P, d) across sections (EXP-CZLIFT-ae0a13 run.py lines 80-118), so torsion-dependent probabilities are approximate.
